about.title: About
about.bio1: My name is Klotilda and I create in Prague. My work grows from a love of traditional crafts — ceramics, embroidery and linocut — which I connect with a contemporary sensibility.
about.bio2: Each piece is made by hand in my studio, without rush. I believe the objects around us can be not only beautiful but deeply personal.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: What customers who really bought from Klotilda say about it.
reviews.source: Only customers who bought from us can write a review, through a link in the e-mail sent when their order is delivered. We publish positive and negative ones alike; we hide only reviews that are vulgar, insulting, spam or carry someone else's personal data.
